posts.title: Windows Sticky Notes
posts.description: Today I learned Windows Sticky Notes are backed by a sqlite database file. If you can access this directory, you can read other users’ sticky notes. C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Packages\Microsoft.MicrosoftStickyNotes_8wekyb3d8bbwe\LocalState\plum.sqlite Don’t store sensitive data in your sticky notes!! posts.title: linux Pipes
posts.description: Linux pipes only work within the same process family tree. If you are piping from procA to procB , they must both have the same parent process (e.g. bash). For inter-process piping between unrelated processes, you can use a named pipe (also called a FIFO - First In, First Out). posts.title: DnsPinger: A Small .NET Tool for Diagnosing DNS Issues in Kubernetes
